workflowRegressionCoverage: Shop selection recovery after initial directory failure; revoked active shops do not silently choose another workspace.
Employee list read/write/edit permissions reject missing or mismatched membership scope.
Persisted React Query list mutations hydrate and resume with their original list IDs and complete API payloads, including quantity, urgency, stock, moves, and shared lists.

sourceReview: AuthContext loads only the current typed account's cached shop directory after a transport failure. A successful refresh replaces the directory and permission projection. A previously unavailable directory can recover the verified saved/default/sole shop; a revoked active shop clears selection without moving queued writes to another shop.
List creation and product addition controls require Write. Rename, quantity editing, urgency, removal and collection controls require Edit. Server authorization remains necessary for every request.
Employee and product-search screens distinguish failed/offline requests from an empty result and provide retry controls.
Product addition sends one request containing quantity instead of making a second request that requires Edit access. Backend contract validation is recorded separately.
